slides.headline: THINGS YOU DIDN'T KNOW *Claude could do*
slides.body: Part 3. Five features almost nobody touches, from a software developer who uses it every day.
slides.close: Parts 1 and 2 are on my page. *Number 4 is the one that got me.*

slides.headline: IT MAKES *real files*
slides.body: Ask for a budget and you get an actual spreadsheet with working formulas, not a table you have to rebuild yourself.
slides.close: Same for docs, slides, and PDFs. They *open and they work*.

slides.headline: IT READS *your screenshots*
slides.body: Paste a photo of a receipt, a graph, or a page too dense to read and it pulls the values out.
slides.close: Not a guess at the numbers. *The actual numbers.*

slides.headline: IT *remembers you*
slides.body: Turn memory on in settings and it carries what it learns about you from one chat to the next.
slides.close: You stop re explaining your job *every single morning*.

slides.headline: IT DOES *real research*
slides.body: Switch on research and it goes and reads dozens of sources, then writes you a report with the links it used.
slides.close: A few minutes of waiting *beats an afternoon of tabs*.

slides.headline: IT CONNECTS TO *your inbox*
slides.body: Hook up your email and calendar and it can look at what is actually in there before it answers you.
slides.close: Ask what am I missing this week and it *actually knows*.

slides.headline: COMMENT *THREE*
slides.body: I will send you all five written out with exactly where to find each one.
slides.close: Free, no email needed. Parts 1 and 2 are on my page, and *part 4 drops next week*.
